text: Imagine… a giant sinkhole opened up downtown.
But under the street, a leaking pipe has been washing the soil away for years.
First, the road sinks a few centimeters.
The police stop the traffic and clear the area.
Then… the whole crossing drops away.
Twenty meters wide. Ninety meters deep.
That is roughly what happened in Guatemala City, in 2010.
Some keep growing. In Florida, in 1981, one reached about one hundred meters across.
One of the deepest, in China, goes down more than five hundred meters.
Deeper than most skyscrapers are tall.
So… what is really under your street?
